Focused protein-protein interaction network highlighting key differentially expressed genes in mitochondrial function

Focused protein-protein interaction network highlighting key differentially expressed genes in mitochondrial function. This subset illustrates the central role of DKK1 connecting mitochondrial proteins to synapse pruning-associated genes, emphasizing potential relationships between these pathways in ASD

View figure at PMC Read paper at PMC

Publication
